body.name: schedule-indexed triangular-array paired confidence envelope
body.construction: For an arbitrary deterministic schedule \(t=(t_n)_{n\ge1}\) with \(t_n>0\) and \(t_n\to0\), define \(\mathrm{CI}_n(t)=[F(\widehat\beta_n)_1-q_{1-\alpha,n}^\star/\sqrt n,\ F(\widehat\beta_n)_2+q_{1-\alpha,n}^\star/\sqrt n]\), where \(\widehat F'_n(g)=\{F(\Pi_{\mathcal B}(\widehat\beta_n+t_ng))-F(\widehat\beta_n)\}/t_n\), both endpoint coordinates use the same multiplier draw, and \(\Pi_{\mathcal B}\) is the row-feasible correction.
